name: Smart Search's note on an auto-collection's details page, at 1366x900: WC AC Note made through the API as admin; its collection's page has the note right above the collection's items (Updates automatically from a saved search · updated …) with Edit (the Auto-collections tab's editor on it) and Refresh now (Updating…, then updated just now and a toast); a movie's page has none, and the collection's page again has one note; viewer sees the text only; on a phone it fits the screen; with ShowCollectionNote off there is none. Screenshots smartsearch-collectionnote*.png.

steps.name: page helpers (admin)
steps.initScript:
window.__ss = {
  root: () => [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-jfss-page="search"][data-jfss-mounted] .jfss-search')].find(x => x.getClientRects().length > 0) || null,
  q: (s) => { const r = window.__ss.root(); return r ? r.querySelector(s) : null; },
  all: (s) => { const r = window.__ss.root(); return r ? [...r.querySelectorAll(s)] : []; },
  noHScroll: () => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= innerWidth && window.__ss.root().scrollWidth <= window.__ss.root().clientWidth + 1,
  box: (e) => { const r = e.getBoundingClientRect(); return [Math.round(r.width), Math.round(r.height)]; },
  api: async (method, path, body) => { const r = await fetch(ApiClient.getUrl(path), { method, headers: { 'X-Emby-Token': ApiClient.accessToken(), 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: body === undefined ? undefined : JSON.stringify(body) }); const t = await r.text(); return { status: r.status, body: t ? JSON.parse(t) : null }; },
  cleanup: async (prefix) => { let n = 0; const acs = (await window.__ss.api('GET', 'SmartSearch/AutoCollections')).body || []; for (const a of acs) { if (a.Name.indexOf(prefix) === 0) { await window.__ss.api('DELETE', 'SmartSearch/AutoCollections/' + a.Id + '?deleteCollection=true'); n++; } } const list = (await window.__ss.api('GET', 'SmartSearch/Queries?scope=Mine&limit=500')).body.Items; for (const q of list) { if (q.Name.indexOf(prefix) === 0) { await window.__ss.api('DELETE', 'SmartSearch/Queries/' + q.Id + '?detachAutoCollections=true'); n++; } } return n; },
  movies: async (name) => { const libs = (await window.__ss.api('GET', 'SmartSearch/Libraries')).body; const movies = libs.find(l => l.Name === 'Movies').Id; return (await window.__ss.api('POST', 'SmartSearch/Queries', { Name: name, Description: '', Shared: false, Query: { Version: 1, Scope: { ItemKinds: ['Movie'], LibraryIds: [movies], IncludeMissing: false }, Where: { Match: 'All', Children: [] }, Sort: [{ Key: 'SortName', Order: 'Ascending' }] } })).body; },
  dialog: () => { const d = [...document.querySelectorAll('[role="dialog"]')].filter(x => x.getClientRects().length > 0); return d[d.length - 1] || null; },
  dq: (s) => { const d = window.__ss.dialog(); return d ? d.querySelector(s) : null; },
  dset: (s, v) => { const e = window.__ss.dq(s); e.value = v; e.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); e.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return true; },
  dbutton: (text) => { const d = window.__ss.dialog(); return d ? [...d.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b => b.textContent === text) || null : null; },
  rows: () => window.__ss.all('.jfss-ac-row'),
  names: () => window.__ss.rows().map(r => r.querySelector('.jfss-ac-open').textContent),
  row: (name) => window.__ss.rows().find(r => r.querySelector('.jfss-ac-open').textContent === name) || null,
  status: (name) => { const r = window.__ss.row(name); return r ? r.querySelector('.jfss-ac-status').textContent : null; },
  action: (name, cls) => { const r = window.__ss.row(name); return r ? r.querySelector(cls) : null; },
  savedRow: (name) => window.__ss.all('.jfss-saved-row').find(r => r.querySelector('.jfss-saved-open').textContent === name) || null,
  toast: () => [...document.querySelectorAll('.jfss-toast')].map(t => t.textContent.replace(/[\u2066-\u2069]/g, '')).join(' | '),
  ready: () => !!window.__ss.q('.jfss-collections-panel') && !!window.__ss.q('.jfss-ac-count') && /auto-collection/.test(window.__ss.q('.jfss-ac-count').textContent + (window.__ss.q('.jfss-ac-notices') || {}).textContent)
};

steps.name: note helpers (admin)
admin: earlier runs removed, WC AC Note made from a query over Movies; its collection's id and a movie's
steps.script: const removed = await __ss.cleanup('WC AC Note'); const q = await __ss.movies('WC AC Note'); const preview = (await __ss.api('POST', 'SmartSearch/AutoCollections/Preview', { Definition: { Name: 'WC AC Note', Source: { SavedQueryId: q.Id } } })).body; const r = await __ss.api('POST', 'SmartSearch/AutoCollections', { Definition: { Name: 'WC AC Note', Source: { SavedQueryId: q.Id } }, AcceptedPreviewHash: preview.PreviewHash }); const movie = (await __ss.api('GET', 'Items?Recursive=true&IncludeItemTypes=Movie&Limit=1&userId=' + ApiClient.getCurrentUserId())).body.Items[0]; return { removed, status: r.status, def: r.body.Id, box: r.body.CollectionId, movie: movie.Id };

steps.name: the note for admin
steps.eval: (() => { const n = __note.node(); const column = n.parentNode; return { text: __note.text(), beforeItems: !!n.nextElementSibling && n.nextElementSibling.classList.contains('collectionItems'), inPrimary: !!column.closest('.detailPagePrimaryContent'), top: Math.round(n.getBoundingClientRect().top), edit: (n.querySelector('a.jfss-ac-note-edit') || {}).textContent, href: (n.querySelector('a.jfss-ac-note-edit') || { getAttribute: () => '' }).getAttribute('href'), refresh: (n.querySelector('button.jfss-ac-note-refresh') || {}).textContent, count: __note.all(), box: __ss.box(n) }; })()

steps.name: right above the collection's items, in view: the text, Edit (the tab's editor) and Refresh now
steps.assert: /^Updates automatically from a saved search · updated (just now|\d+ minutes? ago)$/.test(__vars.admin.text) && __vars.admin.beforeItems && __vars.admin.inPrimary && __vars.admin.top < 600 && __vars.admin.edit === 'Edit' && __vars.admin.href.indexOf('tab=collections') >= 0 && __vars.admin.href.indexOf('edit=' + __vars.made.def.replace(/-/g, '')) >= 0 && __vars.admin.refresh === 'Refresh now' && __vars.admin.count === 1

steps.name: wait a minute, so an update shows a new time
updated again, with its toast
steps.waitFor: /updated just now$/.test(__note.text()) && !__note.node().querySelector('button.jfss-ac-note-refresh').disabled && __ss.toast().indexOf('WC AC Note is up to date.') >= 0

steps.name: the tab's editor on WC AC Note
back on the collection's page (jellyfin-web's view cache)
viewer, in a browser of its own

steps.name: ShowCollectionNote off
steps.script: const id = 'd92488d5-409f-4ad0-af1d-3615db9d0513'; const c = (await __ss.api('GET', 'Plugins/' + id + '/Configuration')).body; c.ShowCollectionNote = false; return (await __ss.api('POST', 'Plugins/' + id + '/Configuration', c)).status;

steps.name: ShowCollectionNote on again
steps.script: const id = 'd92488d5-409f-4ad0-af1d-3615db9d0513'; const c = (await __ss.api('GET', 'Plugins/' + id + '/Configuration')).body; c.ShowCollectionNote = true; return (await __ss.api('POST', 'Plugins/' + id + '/Configuration', c)).status;
